title: Steranko's "Empire"
description: STERANKO'S "EMPIRE" captures the sweep and excitement of George Lucas' epic and served as a cover for the artist's popular Mediascene magazine, now called Prevue. What you see on the front of this card is actually half of the painting; the unseen left side, or "back-cover," is pictured on card #80. Jim Steranko inspired an entire generation of comics fans and pros with his ground breaking style of graphic storytelling. His NICK FURY - AGENT OF SHIELD work for Marvel in the late 60's is still dazzling, even by today's standards.
